QuestInfo.name: Fourth Mission: Double Agent
QuestInfo.0: Ryden says that he has a new mission for you. Go to Kerning City and meet with Ryden.
QuestInfo.1: Ryden says that the Dark Lord's organization has discovered the Dual Blades, and the organization is secretly conducting an investigation. Ryden says that their efforts must be diverted in order to prevent interference with future plans. As a double agent, your mission is to deceive #bEels#k, who is spearheading the Dual Blade investigation. \r\nYou should go see #bEels#k at the #b#m103020200##k.
QuestInfo.2: Ryden said that the Dark Lord's organization discovered the existence of the Dual Blades and were secretly conducting an investigation. He said that their efforts had to be diverted in order to prevent interference with future plans. You met with Eels, who is in charge of investigating the Dual Blades, and passed on false information that should deceive him.
QuestInfo.demandSummary: Complete the #bInvestigating the Suspicious Person#k quest\nComplete the #bFalsified Remnant#k quest

0.0: Psst, over here! Shhh! Keep your voice down... Listen up. It appears that the Dark Lord has learned of our existence. It hasn't gone public, but it looks like he's already started an investigation. We'll obviously need to be a step faster, so I have a dangerous mission with you in mind. Are you ready?

yes.0: According to our sources, #b#p1002102##k received a secret letter from the Dark Lord and has launched an investigation. They think that someone is behind the recent incidents. Of course, I can't say that I'm surprised...
yes.1: Your mission is to #bacquaint yourself with #b#p1002102#, then find out what he knows and what he plans on doing.#k You'll have to become his disciple. In other words, you'll be acting as a double agent. Talk to him first, and then report back to me. He is at the Subway #b#m103020200##k. Be careful, he may look like a janitor, but he is very dangerous.

no.0: Are you nervous? Your nerves are only going to get in the way of this mission.

1.0: Hahaha... So that foolish Eels fell for our trick? That's great! Job well done. I'll be sure to let Lady Syl know, as well. Hmm... I think someone might have overheard our conversation. We have to be more cautious in the future. You better leave now.

quest.0: Your mission is to #bacquaint yourself with Eels, then find out what he knows and what he plans on doing.#k You'll have to become his disciple. In other words, you'll be acting as a double agent. Talk to him first, then report back to me. Be careful, and remember that many eyes are on you.
